properties.decision:
ANTHONY, 2026-08-10, answering four gaps as one: req:vocabulary-covers-information, -materiel, -personnel and -states are DEFERRED as a class.

WHY AS A CLASS. They are one question wearing four hats — does reflow2 model the other UAF domains, or is it deliberately scoped to function and structure? Answering them piecemeal would decide the scope by accident, four times, without anyone noticing they were the same decision. They came from Anthony UAF/DoDAF background (user-se-background-viewpoint-doctrine), so they are real vocabulary a systems engineer expects, not speculative additions.

DEFERRED IS NOT DECLINED. Each is a coherent requirement and none was argued down. What is missing is a PROJECT THAT NEEDS THEM: reflow2 own design has no materiel, no personnel beyond Contributor, and no behavioural state machine, so building the vocabulary now would be declaring types nothing reads — which req:functional-vocabulary-computes forbids in as many words, and which dec:idea-detect-vocabulary-that-nothing-reaches exists to detect.

THE RE-ASK TRIGGER, NAMED SO DEFERRED CANNOT DEGRADE INTO NEVER ASKED AGAIN (the shape dec:the-telemetry-kpp-question-waits-for-flo2 set): re-open when a design reflow2 is actually pointed at needs one of them. Concretely — a project with physical parts to sustain (materiel), an organisation with roles performing activities (personnel), a protocol or device with modelled behavioural states (states), or a data contract whose entities and attributes must cross an interface (information). The bluesky/NSLS-II work is the likeliest source of the last two.

WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS WRONG: if a consumer hits one of these and works around it in prose rather than asking, the deferral will look correct while costing exactly what it was meant to avoid. That is unobservable from inside this design, which is the honest limit of this decision.
properties.name: DEFERRED — whether reflow2 models information, materiel, personnel and state is a SCOPE question, and the re-ask trigger is named rather than left to memory
